verdict.rationale: Capacities documents daily notes, each uniquely linked to one day and aggregating that day's references, and a community user praises its daily-note implementation. Templates can prefill an object's properties and blocks, but the evidence never says they apply to daily notes. Missing for 10: evidence that daily notes are created automatically, evidence that a template applies to daily notes, evidence that the daily note is the default landing place, hands-on corroboration of the journaling workflow.
